android.desc:
Spike is the AI-powered email client that upgrades your inbox.
It replaces confusing threads and cluttered inboxes with a clean, conversational interface — a modern evolution of traditional email. Manage multiple accounts and team collaboration all from one place.

⚡ BUILT FOR PROFESSIONALS & TEAMS
Smarter, faster email with:
• Fewer missed messages
• Faster replies
• Less overwhelm

🧠 AI-POWERED INBOX
• Summarize long threads & attachments instantly
• Draft replies in seconds — AI understands your context
• Clean, focused inbox with smart filters & priority sorting

🛠 FULL INBOX CONTROL
• Translate emails instantly
• Send later, snooze, or mass delete in a tap
• Triage fast with swipe actions & smart sorting

💬 EMAIL THAT FEELS LIKE CHAT
• Group messages by person, not confusing threads
• Looks like regular email for others
• Real-time read indicators & online presence

👥 TEAM PRODUCTIVITY, BUILT-IN
• Create a Teamspace with your domain or get one from us
• Shared inboxes for customer support & workflows
• Team chat, tasks, notes & docs — no switching tools
• Start voice or video calls right from your inbox

📥 ALL-IN-ONE EMAIL & PRODUCTIVITY HUB
 • Unified inbox for Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo & more
 • Works across Android, desktop & web
 • Powerful search across messages & files

🔐 PRIVACY-FIRST
• Your data stays private
• Fully encrypted, no ads, no tracking

🎯 Stop juggling apps and drowning in email. Spike is the modern AI email client that unifies communication, collaboration, and productivity.

🚀 Try Spike for free — your inbox won’t feel the same.
💌 Questions or feedback? Reach us at: chat@spikenow.com
